title: Trtexec with CUDAGraph happen rarely Cuda failure: an illegal memory access was encountered.
body:
## Description
set CUDA_ENABLE_COREDUMP_ON_EXCEPTION=1, it may repro the issue of an illegal memory access but can’t generate cuda dump. why?
with compute-sanitizer or cuda-gdb, i can’t repro the issue so far. why?
When you only run one trtexec, it can’t happen. but 2 and more can happen rarely the illegal memory access. So I suspect it may have memory conflicts between two process.

Two programs:
trtexec --loadEngine=fp16_fusion.trt --device=1 --useCudaGraph --iterations=1000000
trtexec --loadEngine=fp16_fusion.trt --device=1 --useCudaGraph --iterations=1000000

comments.author: oxana-nvidia
comments.body: @lianggangMei We've debugged this issue internally and the problem is in CUDA. I can not share the details here but we are planning to provide a fix in the upcoming CUDA versions.

comments.author: oxana-nvidia
comments.body: @lianggangMei As I said earlier, I can not disclose here the details of the work around we currently have internally for this issue. I don't have a conformation yet which CUDA version is going to have the fix.

comments.author: oxana-nvidia
comments.body: @jackcaron I have not tested this one recently, but I've seen some similar issues fixed in CUDA 12.6. Coming soon TRT 10.4 is supporting 12.6. Please try it when the release is public (should be 1-2 weeks from now).
